title: Architecting Amid Regulations in Finance
summary: Seb Leal Bennett, who leads cloud architecture for a major European bank, joins Security Visionaries to unpack regulation-first design and why sovereignty and resilience aren't the same thing.
body_markdown:
### Seb Leal Bennett
Head of Architecture & Cloud for UBS Investment Bank


Seb Leal Bennett’s experience spans the banking sector in roles including Head of Engineering and Head of Solution Architecture. He is currently Head of Architecture and Cloud at a European investment bank.


### Emily Wearmouth
Director, Integrated Communications at Netskope


Emily Wearmouth is a technology communicator who helps engineers, specialists and tech organisations to communicate more effectively. At Netskope, Emily is responsible for the brand, and for the past 3 years she has also hosted the Security Visionaries podcast. She gets a thrill out of unearthing stories and telling them in a way that helps a wide range of audiences to better understand technology options and benefits.
